officialEnglishCatalog.title: 2026-2027 GRAY SNOWBOARDS PERFECT GUIDE — CARVING CATEGORY
officialEnglishCatalog.evidence: Season-specific official catalog confirms model and both sizes (152 ver.S, 161 ver.S), detailed geometry, Vario Camber, STD Core II and the fiberglass layup icons. It describes ver.S as a sintered-top version for vibration absorption and high-speed carving; Type-X is a pure competition model.

officialJapaneseCatalog.title: 2026-2027 GRAY SNOWBOARDS PERFECT GUIDE (Japanese)
officialJapaneseCatalog.evidence: Corroborates exact size table and official Japanese MSRP ¥180,000 before tax / ¥198,000 tax-inclusive. Its printed 152 N/W/T stiffness values differ from the English edition; preserve both source readings and do not reinterpret or silently resolve.

officialSeasonProduct.evidence: Confirms 26/27 Type-X ver.S identity and manufacturer positioning: advanced competition carving; the 161's longer sidecut radius/wider waist support higher edge angles with less over-turning and drag; the 152 is redesigned for women competitors with a controllable turn-radius range. Marketing claims are not independent snow-test results.

officialSeasonTechnology.evidence: Confirms Type-X as a pure competition model derived from Type-R and 26/27 ver.S's sintered topsheet.

weakPriorSeasonVideo.evidence: Search-indexed video published 2026-01-19 is explicitly a simple review of 25/26 DSPRD Ti Type-X ver.P. Indexed description does not disclose sample size or snow conditions. It is a prior-season different topsheet variant and is not used to calibrate the 26/27 ver.S scores.

unitsAndMapping.effectiveEdgeMm: Catalog Effective Edge L.; kept separate from Contact Length.

unitsAndMapping.setbackMm: Catalog magnitude; direction/sign convention is not specified.
unitsAndMapping.stiffnessNWT: Official 26/27 catalog editions conflict for size 152: English reads 8.4/9.1/8.6 (N/W/T), Japanese reads 8.1/8.8/8.3. Both give 161 as 9.0/9.7/9.2. Seed retains the English-edition values pending manufacturer clarification; these manufacturer figures are not mapped to site flex or editorial scores.
unitsAndMapping.construction: Official catalog construction icons list 2-ply 65/35, STD Core II, and 3-ply 50/50; official description identifies sintered material on the topsheet for ver.S.

scoringReview.decision: Keep all six low-confidence scores unchanged. The official catalog establishes competition intent and construction, not measured ride behavior. The only found snow-test-like material is a brief 25/26 ver.P video without disclosed size or snow conditions; it is not the target season or ver.S. No target-season independent test was found. Float, park, and forgiveness remain especially weakly evidenced. Value is low confidence because CNY 8405 is a converted Japanese MSRP, not China retail.
scoringReview.confidence: low; no target-season ver.S independent test found
